verses.en: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
verses.pt: Rogo-vos pois, irmãos, pela compaixão de Deus, que apresenteis os vossos corpos como um sacrifício vivo, santo e agradável a Deus, que é o vosso culto racional.
verses.en_web: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason I make request to you, brothers, by the mercies of God, that you will give your bodies as a living offering, holy, pleasing to God, which is the worship it is right for you to give him.

verses.en: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
verses.pt: E não vos conformeis a este mundo, mas transformai-vos pela renovação da vossa mente, para que experimenteis qual seja a boa, agradável, e perfeita vontade de Deus.
verses.en_web: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.
verses.en_bbe: And let not your behaviour be like that of this world, but be changed and made new in mind, so that by experience you may have knowledge of the good and pleasing and complete purpose of God.

verses.en: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.
verses.pt: Porque pela graça que me foi dada, digo a cada um dentre vós que não tenha de si mesmo mais alto conceito do que convém; mas que pense de si sobriamente, conforme a medida da fé que Deus, repartiu a cada um.
verses.en_web: For I say, through the grace that was given me, to every man who is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.
verses.en_bbe: But I say to every one of you, through the grace given to me, not to have an over-high opinion of himself, but to have wise thoughts, as God has given to every one a measure of faith.

verses.en: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:
verses.pt: Pois assim como em um corpo temos muitos membros, e nem todos os membros têm a mesma função,
verses.en_web: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,
verses.en_bbe: For, as we have a number of parts in one body, but all the parts have not the same use,

verses.en: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.
verses.pt: assim nós, embora muitos, somos um só corpo em Cristo, e individualmente uns dos outros.
verses.en_web: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members one of another.
verses.en_bbe: So we, though we are a number of persons, are one body in Christ, and are dependent on one another;

verses.en: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;
verses.pt: De modo que, tendo diferentes dons segundo a graça que nos foi dada, se é profecia, seja ela segundo a medida da fé;
verses.en_web: Having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us, if prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;
verses.en_bbe: And having different qualities by reason of the grace given to us, such as the quality of a prophet, let it be made use of in relation to the measure of our faith;

verses.en: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;
verses.pt: se é ministério, seja em ministrar; se é ensinar, haja dedicação ao ensino;
verses.en_web: or service, let us give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;
verses.en_bbe: Or the position of a Deacon of the church, let a man give himself to it; or he who has the power of teaching, let him make use of it;

verses.en: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.
verses.pt: ou que exorta, use esse dom em exortar; o que reparte, faça-o com liberalidade; o que preside, com zelo; o que usa de misericórdia, com alegria.
verses.en_web: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting: he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.
verses.en_bbe: He who has the power of comforting, let him do so; he who gives, let him give freely; he who has the power of ruling, let him do it with a serious mind; he who has mercy on others, let it be with joy.

verses.en: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
verses.pt: O amor seja não fingido. Aborrecei o mal e apegai-vos ao bem.
verses.en_web: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.
verses.en_bbe: Let love be without deceit. Be haters of what is evil; keep your minds fixed on what is good.

verses.en: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;
verses.pt: Amai-vos cordialmente uns aos outros com amor fraternal, preferindo-vos em honra uns aos outros;
verses.en_web: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor preferring one another;
verses.en_bbe: Be kind to one another with a brother's love, putting others before yourselves in honour;

verses.en: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
verses.pt: não sejais vagarosos no cuidado; sede fervorosos no espírito, servindo ao Senhor;
verses.en_web: not lagging in diligence; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
verses.en_bbe: Be not slow in your work, but be quick in spirit, as the Lord's servants;

verses.en: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
verses.pt: alegrai-vos na esperança, sede pacientes na tribulação, perseverai na oração;
verses.en_web: rejoicing in hope; enduring in troubles; continuing steadfastly in prayer;
verses.en_bbe: Being glad in hope, quiet in trouble, at all times given to prayer,

verses.en: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.
verses.pt: acudi aos santos nas suas necessidades, exercei a hospitalidade;
verses.en_web: contributing to the needs of the saints; given to hospitality.
verses.en_bbe: Giving to the needs of the saints, ready to take people into your houses.

verses.en: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.
verses.pt: abençoai aos que vos perseguem; abençoai, e não amaldiçoeis;
verses.en_web: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.
verses.en_bbe: Give blessing and not curses to those who are cruel to you.

verses.en: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
verses.pt: alegrai-vos com os que se alegram; chorai com os que choram;
verses.en_web: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.
verses.en_bbe: Take part in the joy of those who are glad, and in the grief of those who are sorrowing.

verses.en: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.
verses.pt: sede unânimes entre vós; não ambicioneis coisas altivas mas acomodai-vos às humildes; não sejais sábios aos vossos olhos;
verses.en_web: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.
verses.en_bbe: Be in harmony with one another. Do not have a high opinion of yourselves, but be in agreement with common people. Do not give yourselves an air of wisdom.

verses.en: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.
verses.pt: a ninguém torneis mal por mal; procurai as coisas dignas, perante todos os homens.
verses.en_web: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.
verses.en_bbe: Do not give evil for evil to any man. Let all your business be well ordered in the eyes of all men.

verses.en: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
verses.pt: Se for possível, quanto depender de vós, tende paz com todos os homens.
verses.en_web: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
verses.en_bbe: As far as it is possible for you be at peace with all men.

verses.en: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.
verses.pt: Não vos vingueis a vós mesmos, amados, mas dai lugar à ira de Deus, porque está escrito: Minha é a vingança, eu retribuirei, diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”
verses.en_bbe: Do not give punishment for wrongs done to you, dear brothers, but give way to the wrath of God; for it is said in the holy Writings, Punishment is mine, I will give reward, says the Lord.

verses.en: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.
verses.pt: Antes, se o teu inimigo tiver fome, dá-lhe de comer; se tiver sede, dá-lhe de beber; porque, fazendo isto amontoarás brasas de fogo sobre a sua cabeça.
verses.en_web: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”
verses.en_bbe: But if one who has hate for you is in need of food or of drink, give it to him, for in so doing you will put coals of fire on his head.

verses.en: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
verses.pt: Não te deixes vencer do mal, mas vence o mal com o bem.
verses.en_web: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verses.en_bbe: Do not let evil overcome you, but overcome evil by good.
